'''Lola''' was a perky and talkative [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] dancer who went to [[Darkside (space station)|Darkside]] on one payday along with the band that [[Nirama]] had sent. During a break, she had a short conversation with one of Nirama's spies. She had not heard of [[the Cell]], but had heard that some people were not fond of Nirama's leadership, though she was not sure why.
